rationale: Identity was verified correctly via name + zip. However, the agent performed order-changing writes without proper confirmation and did not follow the user’s stated payment preference. Specifically: (1) The bicycle exchange was executed without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy. (2) For both the bicycle and camera exchanges, the agent used the Mastercard payment method (credit_card_8105988) instead of the user’s requested Visa, failing to perform the requested changes correctly. (3) For the camera, while the user consented to proceed, the agent still did not state the exact variant (resolution and options) before submitting the exchange, as required. (4) The agent provided an unsupported explanation for the jigsaw puzzle exchange failure (“only one exchange or return is allowed per delivered order”), which contradicts the tool’s reported error and is not substantiated by the provided policy summary. The skateboard cancellation was deferred to the user per their request, which is fine, but the above issues constitute policy violations and incomplete adherence to the user’s instructions.
